name_zh: 保留对应多解的空间联合分支
formal_object: Each anchor vertex i has finite target modes y_i,k and model scores p_i,k>0; connected anchor graph E; no GT target coordinates.

operations.condition: Candidate support and probabilities come from the same permitted model

operations.input: Posterior-mean coordinate as a universal safe correspondence
operations.condition: Two separated valid modes are possible
operations.output: Averaging can create an unsupported interior point

operations.condition: Modes and pairwise geometry terms are declared
operations.output: Construct a discrete assignment, not a temperature change

operations.input: coordinate mean versus nonlinear latent decoding
operations.condition: nonlinear decoder; actual candidate-coordinate map not established
operations.output: noncommutation prevents inheriting coordinate-mixture semantics from token attention

derivation_steps.statement: For two opposite rotation modes of a vector, their mean can have a smaller norm than either mode.
derivation_steps.justification: This is a conditional mathematical counterexample, not a benchmark case or a claim of natural prevalence.

derivation_steps.statement: Choose labels k_i minimizing sum_i -log p_i,k_i + lambda sum_(i,j) ||(y_i,k_i-y_j,k_j)-R_ij(x_i-x_j)||^2.
derivation_steps.justification: A finite spatial objective rewards coherent mode choices rather than averaging across modes.

derivation_steps.statement: The general discrete objective is nonconvex; beam/message/graph search is approximate and must retain its achieved objective and budget.
derivation_steps.justification: No global optimum follows from the construction.

derivation_steps.statement: In general g(sum_k p_k z_k) != sum_k p_k g(z_k); for g(z)=2sigmoid(z)-1 and equal z=0,2 the values are tanh(1/2) and tanh(1)/2.
derivation_steps.justification: Nonlinear decoding and averaging do not commute. This is a mathematical function-class witness, not an assertion about measured frozen-weight outputs.

derivation_steps.statement: A normalized token attention row does not by itself define a calibrated distribution over target material coordinates.
derivation_steps.justification: Keys/values are latent features, and the inspected native API emits a single coordinate after nonlinear layers. A semantic candidate map and calibration require additional evidence.

derivation_steps.statement: The same finite labeling objective can use -log(normalized positive scores) as unary energies without claiming Bayes posterior optimality.
derivation_steps.justification: Normalization defines mathematical weights; label optimization is still a declared energy construction. All arms must share the actual candidate support, geometry hints, lift and budget.

derivation_steps.statement: Localized positive-weight surface blends lie in the candidate convex hull, not necessarily on the surface. Equal nearby points on a sphere with chord length ell have radial deficit R-sqrt(R^2-ell^2/4)=ell^2/(8R)+O(ell^4/R^3).
derivation_steps.justification: Use x_plus/minus=(R cos theta,+/-R sin theta,0). The mean is inside even for arbitrarily small positive theta. This mathematical counterexample does not establish natural prevalence or final lifted-mesh failure.

assumptions: Separated modes must be exposed by an actual inspected model interface; attention confidence alone is not calibrated probability.
Spatial coherence may choose the wrong symmetric part; no unique identity is guaranteed.
Rotation hints R_ij must use legal model/anchor information and identical availability for comparators.
No full dense 32768-token attention tensor is presumed feasible on this GPU.
The public native decoder returns coordinates, not a candidate-mode posterior.
Positive normalized scores may be unary energies without calibrated posterior meaning.
method_expression: Extract a bounded candidate set per landmark, perform spatially coherent discrete label search, and lift selected targets with a qualified common deformation backend.
distinguishing_prediction: Benefit should concentrate on separated correspondence modes; a mean blend can improve an average score while compressing the predicted shape. This applies only after a real coordinate bank is qualified, not directly to native attention entropy. Local mean off-surface deficit can scale as curvature times squared candidate spread; this alone does not establish a joint-label advantage.
falsifier: Reject if naturally sourced modes are unimodal, or independent top-1/temperature-matched means match the same native performance at equal search cost. An absent or semantically unqualified candidate interface blocks instantiation and is not an empirical KILL.
closest_alternative: STAC's localized sharp blend; independent top-1; classical discrete labeling. Historical m03 also selects candidates over time, so spatial joint mode preservation needs explicit collision review.
decisive_comparison: Common native inputs, candidates and deformation backend: sharp mean, independent top-1 and spatial joint labels; full official CD-M/3D/4D and matched search budget. Add the same-bank surface-projected mean to distinguish simple off-surface repair from joint identity selection.
operational_delta: Changes posterior reduction and joint spatial decision, not just top-k or temperature; functional originality is unresolved.
feasibility_and_cost: Sparse/chunked attention capture and bounded landmark search are required. Interfaces, lifting baseline and full-mesh memory remain unqualified.
structural_signature: Discrete spatial mode assignment before deformation, as opposed to continuous averaging or mass balancing.
algebra_review_basis: Variance identity and collapse counterexample rechecked. No promise of correct correspondence or a polynomial global solver.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.

revision.scope: Conditional mathematical and interface revision; no native experiment or implementation.
